title: What Learning Playlist Engines Is
definition: Learning Playlist Engines: playlists sequencing learning like music.

title: Real Research Today: Learning Playlist Engines
definition: Today's documented research behind Learning Playlist Engines.
description:
The road to Learning Playlist Engines is already being paved. Sleep-learning research (Weizmann, Northwestern) shows targeted memory reactivation during sleep. Finland's phenomenon-based learning reorganizes school around topics, not subjects.

Carnegie Mellon's Open Learning Initiative proved adaptive courseware doubles learning rates. Together these programs form the sequence algorithms foundation that Learning Playlist Engines will build on — the engine logistics results, the taste profiles methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as engine logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Learning Playlist Engines Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Learning Playlist Engines: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Learning Playlist Engines — playlists sequencing learning like music.

Phase 1 — Prove (sequence algorithms): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (engine logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (taste profiles): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (completion nudges): engine hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and learners-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
